description: Adds project files to the mod's ARCropolis config.json from the Explorer right-click menu.
error.outside: Only files in the sources folder go in config.json.
error.no-dir: This file is at the root of the mod: it has no folder to add it to.
error.invalid-config: config.json isn't valid JSON or doesn't have the expected structure. Fix it first, nothing was changed.
